data.gender_notes: Nusairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'naseerah' which means 'help' or 'assistance'. In Islam, the name Nusairah is given to those who strive to support and help others, embodying the spirit of compassion and kindness. The name Nusairah carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusairah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusairah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
